title: Integration
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

All the service types that do not correspond to one of the predefined service categories can be allocated to the Other

service category. If you want to continue using a service type based on the Other service category internally, you must
modify the templates individually.

e Service provider as a service agent
For more information on service providers, see service providers .
e Validity period of service

In the case of a billable service (contract), the validity period is based on the move-in and move-out dates. The service type
is contained in the corresponding installation.

Integration

The non-billable are modeled as an own entity in the point of delivery. This is why they are referred to as point of delivery services.

Service                                    Contract

Non-billable                     Billable
